title: Ruleset hardening: promote four legacy warning rules to Error
summary: Four legacy compiler warning rules are promoted to errors, requiring fixes across permission sets and removing or scoping unreachable code and table references in test and production objects.
key_points: AS0103 and PTE0004 promote identical warning rules affecting 176 physical tables through 142 shared scopes, with 34 production tables added to permission sets
AS0011 promotes a warning for 47 established identifiers including 17 legacy test objects and 30 published app objects whose renaming would break references
AA0136 promotes a warning, removing 37 instances of unreachable code across 29 physical files with one restored public API and selective scoping to preserve behavior
Permission sets expanded for Russian, SL, and QB migration tables; clean permission baseline compatibility managed through scopes
CI reconciliation across three waves eliminated 218 deduplicated diagnostics with selective restoration of one externally visible legacy procedure
quote: Promotes AS0103, PTE0004, AS0011, and AA0136 from Warning to the repository default Error posture.
